falsification_predictions.claim_limit: These are frozen compact-model predictions for a future experiment, not measurements or evidence of physical programmability.

linear_erlang_v1.claim_limit: Erlang-exact computational sensitivity. It is not the nonlinear headroom equation and does not identify microscopic stages.
linear_erlang_v1.upstream_transfer: V_max*drive for stage 1; raw v_previous thereafter

physical_headroom_v1.claim_limit: Equation-matching computational device model. Its effective cascade depth is a representation parameter, not an identified microscopic trap count.

numbered_falsifiers.falsifier: a reproducible zero-lag maximum under the frozen deposit and read protocol
numbered_falsifiers.prediction: a resolved non-zero pulse-off eligibility peak

numbered_falsifiers.falsifier: future confidence intervals miss the simultaneous model band at two adjacent predeclared biases
numbered_falsifiers.prediction: preferred lag shifts with bias inside the frozen band

numbered_falsifiers.falsifier: normalised low-drive responses fail to converge or the departure has the opposite amplitude trend
numbered_falsifiers.prediction: low occupancy approaches the frozen low-signal response and headroom saturation produces the recorded departure

identifiability.claim_limit: All 18 in-domain records are repeated traces from one Au device; held-out bias prediction and repeat uncertainty do not establish device-population generality or microscopic stage count.
identifiability.interpretation: The data resolve a compressed rise when the beta interval excludes one, but cascade depth is not identified unless the predeclared support rule passes.

support_bootstrap.depth_identification_rule: exactly one linear k has within-tolerance frequency >=0.95 and all other linear k candidates have frequency <=0.05
support_bootstrap.interpretation: Uncertainty in held-out prediction scores is resampled at the recorded repeat level; training-fold kinetics remain frozen.

working_information_criteria.assumptions: Common sampled time grid; independent Gaussian residual working model; global kinetics plus per-trace amplitude/offset and one noise scale.
working_information_criteria.claim_limit: Trace residuals are temporally correlated and the kinetics were fitted with robust loss; held-out prediction takes precedence.
